title: dinner
summary: A meal name that travelled—and changed its timetable.
question: Has dinner always meant an evening meal?
completion: Dinner was borrowed from Old French disner. Its earlier meaning involved the first meal after fasting. In English it names the main meal, whose time varies by period and community.
partner: A familiar word can carry a surprising history. Follow the evidence!
